100-oldest-unresolved-tickets.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT tickets.id, tickets.subject
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status IN ('awaiting_user', 'awaiting_agent')
ORDER BY tickets.date_created
LIMIT 100
100-oldest-unresolved-tickets.title: 100 oldest unresolved tickets

average-time-to-resolve-tickets-past-mon.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT AVG(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_resolved) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_created)) / 60*60 AS 'Average Time (Hours)'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'resolved' AND tickets.date_created = %PAST_MONTH%
average-time-to-resolve-tickets-past-mon.title: Average time to resolve tickets in past month

average-time-to-resolve-tickets-past-wee.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT AVG(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_resolved) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_created)) / 60*60 AS 'Average Time (Hours)'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'resolved' AND tickets.date_created = %PAST_WEEK%
average-time-to-resolve-tickets-past-wee.title: Average time to resolve tickets in past week

average-time-to-resolve-tickets-past-yea.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT AVG(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_resolved) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_created)) / 60*60 AS 'Average Time (Hours)'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'resolved' AND tickets.date_created = %PAST_YEAR%
average-time-to-resolve-tickets-past-yea.title: Average time to resolve tickets in past year

most-popular-ticket-email-domains.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT()
FROM tickets
GROUP BY tickets.person_email.email_domain
ORDER BY COUNT() DESC
LIMIT 100
most-popular-ticket-email-domains.title: Most popular ticket email domains

percentage-tickets-replied-agent-within-.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT PERCENT(tickets.total_to_first_reply < 3600) AS 'Percentage'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.total_to_first_reply > 0
percentage-tickets-replied-agent-within-.title: Percentage of tickets replied to by an agent within an hour of opening

percentage-tickets-resolved-24-hours.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT PERCENT(tickets.date_resolved <> NULL AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_resolved) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_created) < 24*60*60)
FROM tickets
percentage-tickets-resolved-24-hours.title: Percentage of tickets resolved within 24 hours

tickets-awaiting-agent-grouped-by-depart.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT tickets.subject, tickets.date_created
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'awaiting_agent'
GROUP BY tickets.department, tickets.agent
tickets-awaiting-agent-grouped-by-depart.title: Tickets awaiting agent grouped by department and agent

tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-date-c.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT tickets.subject, tickets.date_created, tickets.person, tickets.agent
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'awaiting_agent'
ORDER BY tickets.date_created
tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-date-c.title: Tickets awaiting agent ordered by date created

tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-last-a.query:

tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-last-a.title: Tickets awaiting agent ordered by last agent reply

tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-last-u.query:
DISPLAY TABLE

tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-number.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT tickets_messages.ticket.subject, COUNT() AS 'Total Messages', tickets_messages.ticket.agent
FROM tickets_messages
WHERE tickets_messages.ticket.status = 'awaiting_agent'
GROUP BY tickets_messages.ticket_id
ORDER BY COUNT() DESC
tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-number.title: Tickets awaiting agent ordered by number of messages

tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-time-w.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT tickets.agent, tickets.subject, tickets.date_user_waiting
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'awaiting_agent'
ORDER BY tickets.agent, tickets.date_user_waiting
tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-time-w.title: Tickets awaiting agent ordered by time waiting

users-most-time-waiting-ticket-replies-p.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT SUM(tickets.total_to_first_reply) / 60*60 AS 'Total Wait (Hours)', COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets', AVG(tickets.total_to_first_reply) / 60*60 AS 'Average Wait (Hours)'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.date_created = %PAST_YEAR%
GROUP BY tickets.person
ORDER BY SUM(tickets.total_to_first_reply) DESC
LIMIT 100
users-most-time-waiting-ticket-replies-p.title: Users with most time waiting for replies in past year
